known_gap.reason: The current cure mechanism (credlens.generation.payments._decide_payment_amount's has_backlog branch) always pays off a contract's ENTIRE remaining balance, not just its overdue backlog - so a cured contract always becomes 'settled' (terminal) the same month, with no remaining balance left to ever become delinquent on again. This is architectural, not a contract_coverage tuning problem - no configuration of on_time/partial/cure/reversal probabilities can produce this state under the current generator. See docs/counterfactual_scenarios.md 'contract_coverage known gap' for the concrete, scoped fix (pay only the overdue backlog on cure) proposed for a future phase.
